listing.aiSummary: Adds a collection of rare, low-weight custom weapons including shielded missiles and shield projectors.

description: Introduces various unique weapons such as shielded missiles, weapons that project shields, and a sawn-off sabot. These items are weighted to appear rarely in gameplay. The mod prioritizes fun over strict balance.
descriptionHtml: Introduces various unique weapons such as shielded missiles, weapons that project shields, and a sawn-off sabot. These items are weighted to appear rarely in gameplay. The mod prioritizes fun over strict balance.
discordPostHtml:
Just a bunch of weapons I made that I thought were cool but couldn't find anywhere to put them. Weighted pretty low so its rare you'll see any of them.

Examples:

  • Shielded Missiles
  • Weapons that just project shields
  • A sawn-off sabot

This is what I call a fucko mod. Pristine balance is not a concern and I will probably not support it forever

Save to add to new games, not safe to remove.

Download: https://github.com/nikothedude/Niko-SWP/releases
Repo: https://github.com/nikothedude/Niko-SWP
